mechanism_narrative: A decline in the federal funds rate over the past month signals an accommodative monetary policy stance that reduces the cost of capital for corporations, leading to higher equity valuations and positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 55% of months when FEDFUNDS declines by at least 0.10 percentage points.

mechanism_narrative: When the federal funds rate falls below 0.25% and remains there for two consecutive months, it signals an extreme monetary easing environment that typically precedes a 5-day positive S&P 500 return due to increased liquidity in financial markets.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are negative in more than 50% of the months meeting the trigger condition.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous decline in unemployment rate and increase in retail sales (RSAFS) indicates a strengthening labor market and consumer spending, which together drive positive equity returns as corporate earnings growth accelerates.
failure_condition: The joint signal of UNRATE decline and RSAFS increase fails to produce positive 60-day returns in more than 55% of cases, or the interaction term in a regression has a coefficient not significantly different from zero (p>0.05).

mechanism_narrative: In a late-cycle economic expansion, rising housing starts (HOUST) above 550,000 units per month signal strong consumer confidence and increased construction activity, which typically leads to positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 55% of periods when HOUST exceeds 550,000 units and the economy is in a late-cycle expansion as defined by a 6-month GDP growth rate above 2.5%.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in industrial production (INDPRO) above its 12-month moving average indicates robust manufacturing activity, which correlates with rising corporate profits and positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: INDPRO above 12-month MA fails to produce positive 5-day returns in more than 55% of observations, or the correlation with SPX returns is not statistically significant (p>0.05).

mechanism_narrative: When retail sales (RSAFS) growth exceeds 0.5% month-over-month for two consecutive months, it signals strong consumer demand that typically precedes a 60-day positive S&P 500 return as companies benefit from higher sales.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are negative in more than 55% of the months meeting the RSAFS growth trigger.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous decline in the federal funds rate and a decline in the unemployment rate indicates a coordinated monetary and labor market stimulus, which together drive positive equity returns as the economy avoids recession and corporate earnings improve.
failure_condition: The joint decline in FEDFUNDS and UNRATE fails to produce positive 20-day returns in more than 55% of cases, or the interaction term in a regression model is not significant (p>0.05).

mechanism_narrative: In a high inflation environment (CPIAUCSL > 3.0% annually), a rise in the federal funds rate above 2.0% signals a monetary tightening cycle that increases discount rates and reduces equity valuations, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are positive in more than 55% of periods when CPIAUCSL > 3.0% and FEDFUNDS > 2.0%.
